description: Static canonical JSON vectors for identity-bearing values. Canonical JSON text is UTF-8; expected_utf8_base64 is the exact byte sequence.

rules.unicode_normalization: none at the universal layer; typed fields must declare their own normalization
rules.decimal: decimal-1 tagged object with ASCII normalized value, max 38 total digits and scale 18; reject noncanonical forms
rules.url: url-1 tagged absolute http/https value; lowercase scheme and DNS host only, preserve path/query/port/trailing slash
rules.missing_vs_null: missing property is omitted; explicit null is retained

cases.name: object-key-order
cases.purpose: Object insertion order does not affect canonical bytes.
cases.rule: Sort object keys by RFC 8785 ordering.

cases.name: nested-values
cases.purpose: Canonicalization recurses through objects and preserves array order.
cases.rule: Sort object keys recursively; never sort arrays implicitly.

cases.name: unicode-and-escapes
cases.purpose: Unicode is UTF-8 and control/quote characters use JSON escaping.
cases.rule: Do not apply universal Unicode normalization; encode canonical text as UTF-8.

cases.name: explicit-null
cases.purpose: Null is distinct from an omitted property.
cases.rule: An explicit null participates in the input; a missing optional field does not.

cases.name: integer-range
cases.purpose: Signed integers retain their exact mathematical value.
cases.rule: Use integers within the protocol's declared safe range; reject overflow.

cases.name: opaque-numeric-string
cases.purpose: An ordinary string is not implicitly interpreted as a decimal.
cases.rule: Only a tagged decimal-1 value is an exact decimal; ordinary strings remain application data.

cases.name: timestamp-string
cases.purpose: Timestamps use an explicit UTC representation.
cases.rule: Typed timestamp fields require RFC 3339 UTC and fixed precision.

cases.name: array-ordering
cases.purpose: Arrays are ordered sequences, not sets.
cases.rule: A tool contract must sort a logical set before it enters identity-bearing input.

cases.name: negative-zero
cases.purpose: Avoid language disagreement about signed zero.
cases.rule: Reject negative zero in identity-bearing input even though JSON.stringify may emit 0.

cases.name: non-finite-number
cases.purpose: NaN and infinities are not JSON values.
cases.rule: Reject before serialization.

cases.name: unsupported-language-object
cases.input_description: Date object, class instance, function, cyclic object, or native byte buffer without an explicit wire representation
cases.rule: Require an explicit typed wire representation.

cases.name: duplicate-object-key
cases.purpose: Parsers must not silently choose between duplicate members.
cases.input_description: Raw JSON text containing duplicate object member names
cases.rule: Reject duplicate keys before canonicalization.

cases.name: decimal-noncanonical-forms
cases.rule: Require decimal-1 normalized form; do not silently normalize.

cases.name: url-scheme-host
cases.normalization_note: HTTPS://EXAMPLE.COM/resource is normalized to this value before JCS.
cases.rule: Lowercase scheme and DNS host only.

cases.name: url-path-query-preservation
cases.rule: Preserve path case, query order, and repeated parameters.

cases.name: url-port-trailing-slash
cases.rule: Preserve explicit ports and trailing slash distinctions.

cases.name: url-rejected-forms
cases.rule: Reject rather than apply provider-specific normalization.

cases.name: empty-values
cases.purpose: Empty values have stable, distinct forms.
cases.rule: Do not omit or stringify empty JSON values.

cases.name: safe-integer-boundaries
cases.rule: Use the inclusive IEEE-754 safe-integer range.

cases.name: integer-out-of-range
cases.purpose: Integers that JavaScript cannot represent exactly are rejected.
cases.rule: Use a decimal string or an application-defined encoded representation instead.

cases.name: malformed-unicode
cases.purpose: Unpaired UTF-16 surrogates are not silently encoded.
cases.input_description: A string containing an unpaired high or low surrogate
cases.rule: Require valid Unicode scalar values before UTF-8 encoding.

cases.name: preimage-at-limit
cases.purpose: The size boundary is measured after canonicalization and before the domain prefix.
cases.input_description: A valid identity preimage whose canonical UTF-8 representation is exactly 65536 bytes
cases.rule: The engine accepts canonical identity-preimage UTF-8 length <= 65536 bytes.

cases.name: preimage-over-limit
cases.purpose: Oversized identity input fails before claim.
cases.input_description: A valid identity preimage whose canonical UTF-8 representation is 65537 bytes
cases.rule: The 64 KiB limit excludes the domain prefix and applies to canonical UTF-8 bytes.
